question: Which of the following sportspersons was conferred the Padma Bhushan Award in 2020?
solution:
The correct answer is **P V Sindhu**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **P V Sindhu** is a renowned Indian badminton player.
 
• She was conferred the **Padma Bhushan** in 2020, which is India's third-highest civilian award.
 
• Sindhu has also been awarded the **Padma Shri** in 2015 and the **Rajiv Gandhi Khel Ratna** in 2016.
